layout: row-major; west-to-east within rows; north-to-south between rows
poleSampling: Clamp latitude to the nearest sampled row; the poles are not separate samples.

source.title: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 v1 60 arc-second Ice Surface elevation
processing: Select every 15th source sample starting at index 7 on both axes; no averaging or interpolation.
Rotate source longitudes 0..360 by 720 columns to store -180..180.
Round each Float32 elevation to the nearest whole metre; write signed little-endian Int16.

limitations: The 0.25-degree samples are approximately 28 km apart at the equator; they represent regional relief, not harbour or ship-scale terrain.
Subsampling is nearest-point selection, not average relief; narrow peaks, islands, trenches and coast detail may be absent.
Modern ETOPO 2022 geography and ice-surface elevations are not a reconstruction of 1922 or 1936.
No vertical exaggeration is baked into this file. Renderer exaggeration must remain a separate setting.
Use the game coastline geometry to clip land; this coarse elevation grid does not define navigable water or vessel grounding.
